title: The Archive of the Kuiper Line
author: Zephyrine Crane
blurb: Elodie Ishikawa, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
